arabic text: AYYA WICH BAZAARA(N) HAAY KYU(N), AYYA WICH\nBAZAARA(N) ZEHRA DIYA JAYYA(N)
english translation text: Why were Zahra’s daughters brought into the marketplaces?\nWhy were Zahra’s daughters brought into the marketplaces?

arabic text: HO KYU NO NO,HO KYU NO NO MEEL TURAIYYAN
english translation text: Why were they made to walk mile after mile?

arabic text:
NO MILANDHI MANZAL REHGAYI,ZEHRA JAYI UTH TO
LEHGAYI,RO PAYYA RAT PUTTAR DE AKHIYA(N),BIBI
THAK KE KHAK TE BEHGAYI
KIWE TTOREYAA(N),KIWE TOREYAA(N) HAAN
SIPAIYYAA(N)
english translation text:
The destination seemed never to arrive; Zahra’s daughter was made to rise and move on.
The son wept tears of blood from his eyes, while the Lady,
exhausted, sat down upon the dust.
How did the soldiers force them onward?
How did the soldiers force them onward?

arabic text:
JERE QATIL WAJHULLAH DE,DAAWE DAARSI
HAZBULLAH DE,HAAY BATOOL DE GHARNU
LUTEYAA,BEYTHE HAI BAZAR SAJAKE
RULGAYYA,HAA(N) RULAGAYYA DARD SATAIYYAA(N)
english translation text:
Those who claimed allegiance to Wajhullah and
called themselves Hizbullah—alas— plundered Batool’s home and
sat watching a marketplace arranged for them. Zahra’s
daughters were disgraced and tormented by pain.

arabic text:
JEN DI CHADAR SADKE BACHIYAA,SAJDA KALMA
DEEN-E-KHUDA DA,SAARE EHSAA(N) BHULGAY
DUNIYAA,KIWE BADLA PAAYA WAFA DA
UNNA SHAANE,HAA(N) UNA SHAANE RASIYYA PAYYA(N)
english translation text:
The veil by whose blessing prostration, the kalima
and God’s religion were preserved— the world
forgot every favour. How did they repay
that loyalty? Ropes were placed upon their shoulders.

arabic text:
WICH SINE DE DARD BHIRAADAA(N),RONDHI
RONDHI KARDI NAWHA,BHEYRA(N) PAAS DI
BAZAARA(N) WICH,PARDI RAY HAYE NAWHAR DADA
HAAYE RULGAY,HAAYE RULGAY ZEHRA JAIYYA(N)
english translation text:
With the pain of her brothers in her
chest, she wept and continued to recite lament
after lament. Passing through the marketplaces, she continued
reciting her lament. Alas, Zahra’s daughters were disgraced.

arabic text:
CHAAR SAALAA(N) DA SUN HAI LOKO,SAEN RABAAB
DI BACHRI DA,GIN SAYYED ZINDAAN WICH
AAYA,LAASHA KAIDEN WAKHRI DA
KE O PE GAYAAN,HAA(N) O PE GAYYA(N) HAAL
DUHAIYYA(N)
english translation text:
People, listen to the four-year-old daughter of Lady Rubab.
When the Sayyid entered the prison,
he found the body of the little captive apart from the others.
What state had befallen her—
what cries of anguish rose there!
